entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
I need to start a return. My order number is VF88-PULSE-019.

Okay, one moment while I pull that up... VF88-PULSE-019. Got it. I see the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor. To make sure I'm documenting this correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's a preference. It's just really hard to use and the interface is confusing. I read the user manual, but I honestly expected more. I just want the return, not a big discussion.
I understand completely. No problem at all. Let me just quickly check the return eligibility for you. I see here it was delivered on December 19th, about 16 days ago.
Right. So can I return it or not?
Yes, absolutely. According to our policy, items can be returned within 90 days of delivery, so you are well within that timeframe. I've just processed the return authorization for you.
I've just sent a prepaid return shipping label to the email address on your account. Just print it out, attach it to the box, and drop it off. Once we receive it, you'll get a full refund.
Fine. That's all I needed. Thanks.
You're welcome. Thanks for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
